info.name: Pacientes API
info.description: CRUD de pacientes (Laravel): listagem com filtros e ordenação, exportação CSV, lixeira, restauração, histórico de alterações, verificação de CPF endereço e consulta de CEP, foto do paciente, e atendimentos (agenda, prontuário, receita em PDF, anexos de exames e linha do tempo). Uploads usam os arquivos de postman/fixtures: rode o newman com --working-dir php-laravel/postman. Contrato: docs/API_CONTRACT.md. Execute em ordem (Runner/newman).

exec: // updated entries, newest first: photo removed, photo added, name only (PATCH), name + address (PUT).

pm.test('Newest first: restored, deleted, 4x updated, created', function () { pm.expect(j.data.map(a => a.event)).to.eql(['restored', 'deleted', 'updated', 'updated', 'updated', 'updated', 'created']); });

pm.test('Update records only changed fields (address as address.<field>)', function () { const u = j.data[5]; pm.expect(u.changes).to.not.have.property('cpf'); pm.expect(u.changes.name).to.eql({ old: 'Maria da Silva', new: 'Maria da Silva Souza' }); pm.expect(u.changes['address.cep']).to.eql({ old: '01310100', new: '20040020' }); });

pm.test('Created has every field with old null, user_id null', function () { const c = j.data[6]; pm.expect(c.changes.cpf).to.eql({ old: null, new: pm.collectionVariables.get('cpf') }); pm.expect(c.user_id).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('Deleted/restored have empty changes object', function () { pm.expect(j.data[0].changes).to.eql({}); pm.expect(j.data[1].changes).to.eql({}); });

pm.test('Photo changes carry markers, never the image', function () { pm.expect(j.data[3].changes).to.eql({ photo: { old: null, new: 'adicionada' } }); pm.expect(j.data[2].changes).to.eql({ photo: { old: null, new: 'removida' } }); });
pm.test('PATCH records only the sent field', function () { pm.expect(j.data[4].changes).to.eql({ name: { old: 'Maria da Silva Souza', new: 'Maria da Silva Souza Lima' } }); });
